en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an indoor industrial or workshop scene. Several uniformed men, likely soldiers, are working among large piles of metal objects such as bowls, plates, and scrap parts. The room has rough plastered walls, heavy wooden posts, overhead beams, and simple hanging lamps. The overall appearance suggests a wartime collection or sorting station for metal goods.
